idh.reasoning: The IDH-status assessment is based only on the MRI metadata. The strongest support for IDH-wildtype biology is the advanced age in age_years, together with an aggressive infiltrative pattern reflected by Multifocal or Multicentric, Number of lesions, Side of Tumor Epicenter, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, Deep WM invasion, ED Volume (mL), Edema crosses midline, and Proportion of Oedema. The presence of enhancement in ET Volume (mL), although mild, also supports a more aggressive adult diffuse glioma phenotype. T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present is absent, which does not support the classic IDH-mutant astrocytoma mismatch pattern. Features arguing against IDH-wildtype include frontal/cortical involvement in Tumor Location and Cortical involvement, mild rather than marked enhancement in Enhancement Quality, and very small necrotic burden in NCR Volume (mL) and Proportion Necrosis. Overall, the age and infiltrative multifocal/ependymal pattern outweigh the lower-grade-appearing elements, supporting IDH-wildtype.

overall_comment: The predictions are based solely on structured conventional MRI metadata and remain less certain than tissue-based molecular testing. The very large FLAIR/edema component, multifocality, bilateral involvement, deep white matter invasion, and ependymal invasion are concerning for aggressive disease, while the enhancing and necrotic components are relatively small and enhancement is described as mild.
